label: input token p in the first four original positions (t<=3)
explanation: Fires exactly when the input token is p at original positions 0-3; never fires for any other input token and never for p at original positions 4+. Dev precision 1.0, recall 0.997. Magnitude depends on position: t=0-2 give strong activations (~0.85-1.0 of max, with p after i at t=1 reaching the max), while t=3 is much weaker (~0.35-0.45 of max), so t=3 holds only ~12% of the mass despite a similar number of firings. It does not fire on the delimiter or in the copy phase, apart from a tiny residual (197 steps, ~0% of mass) when p is fed back as input at copy step t=5 in L=3 sequences.

issues: No systematic gaps. On the test split: precision 1.0, recall 0.997, F1 0.998, mass recall 0.9997, and 0 false positives.

Every one of the 210 test misses is in the claimed residual class: p fed back as input at copy step t=5 in L=3 sequences (original position 1 was p), with weak activation (0.02-0.18 of max) and 0.0% of the mass. On the dev split there is also one stray activation at t=7.

The profile matches the explanation. All activation mass is on in_tok=p. Nothing fires at original positions 4-8. At t=0, 1, 2 and 3 the feature fires about equally often, but t=3 holds only 12.5% of the mass, against 28-31% for each of t=0-2, which matches the weaker activation claimed at t=3.
Recall in the lowest activation quartile is 0.987. That shortfall is just the weak copy-phase residual.
